direct_market.order_script:
LET side   = PREVSTATE ( 2 )
LET limit  = PREVSTATE ( 3 )
LET size   = PREVSTATE ( 4 )
LET maker  = PREVSTATE ( 5 )
LET refund = PREVSTATE ( 6 )
LET basetok  = PREVSTATE ( 8 )
LET quotetok = PREVSTATE ( 9 )
LET mpub   = PREVSTATE ( 10 )
LET escrow = PREVSTATE ( 11 )
LET pa = STATE ( 30 + @INPUT )
LET action = STATE ( 23 )

IF action EQ 2 THEN
  ASSERT SIGNEDBY ( mpub )
  ASSERT VERIFYOUT ( pa refund escrow @TOKENID FALSE )
  RETURN TRUE
ENDIF

ASSERT action EQ 1
LET f = STATE ( 40 + @INPUT )
ASSERT f GT 0
ASSERT f LTE size
LET quotef = ( ( f * limit ) / 100000000 )
LET newsize = ( size - f )

IF side EQ 2 THEN
  ASSERT VERIFYOUT ( pa maker quotef quotetok FALSE )
  IF newsize GT 0 THEN
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 2 2 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 3 3 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 5 5 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 6 6 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 7 7 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 8 8 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 9 9 )
    ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 10 10 )
    ASSERT STATE ( 4 ) EQ newsize
    ASSERT STATE ( 11 ) EQ newsize
    ASSERT VERIFYOUT ( ( pa + 1 ) @ADDRESS newsize basetok TRUE )
  ENDIF
  RETURN TRUE
ENDIF

ASSERT side EQ 1
ASSERT VERIFYOUT ( pa maker f basetok FALSE )
IF newsize GT 0 THEN
  LET newescrow = ( escrow - quotef )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 2 2 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 3 3 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 5 5 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 6 6 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 7 7 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 8 8 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 9 9 )
  ASSERT SAMESTATE ( 10 10 )
  ASSERT STATE ( 4 ) EQ newsize
  ASSERT STATE ( 11 ) EQ newescrow
  ASSERT VERIFYOUT ( ( pa + 1 ) @ADDRESS newescrow quotetok TRUE )
ENDIF
RETURN TRUE
direct_market.note: Direct-take price-time CLOB (PROVEN on-chain 2026-07-21). A taker spends the maker order coins it crosses and pays each maker its OWN limit; a market order is one sweep txn; the marginal order partial-fills and re-rests. No keeper, no clearing coin, no shared state. Order state ports: 2 side(1=BUY,2=SELL) 3 limit(1e8) 4 size 5 maker 6 refund 7 minCoinage 8 basetok 9 quotetok 10 makerpub 11 escrow. Take block: 23 action(1=take,2=cancel) 30+@INPUT maker-payment slot 40+@INPUT fill. Last price = observed trades.

book_anchor.note: Rolling on-chain book anchor (founder-approved 2026-07-23; Phases 0-3 + delta + adversarial core PROVEN on mainnet same day - journal tools/tv81/anchor/anchor-deployment-journal.json). Publishers post bounded PAGE coins (order coinexport blobs; payload state port 20, page hash port 8) then one HEAD coin committing to the page set (pages_root port 7 = SHA2(snapId||u16 pageCount||u16 orderCount||pageHashes); page coin-id list port 20). Readers track both addresses at boot, forward-capture the next snapshot via ordinary sync, validate hashes/root locally, and import order proofs - no HTTP/Maxima/MegaMMR in the critical path; a publisher can only withhold, never forge. Family tag port 0 (1=page, 2=head) is covenant-enforced on spend. Head/page coins are owner-refreshable visibility artifacts; ORDER coins are never refreshed.

book_sources.note: Common-book provider discovery (founder-approved 2026-07-21, PROVEN on-chain: post + third-party refusal + owner heartbeat refresh). Book sources rest heartbeat-refreshed POINTER COINS here; only the owner (state port 10 pubkey) can spend/refresh a pointer. Pointer state: 0 tag(21) 1 endpoint(hex utf8 URL) 2 coverage-since-height(0=full) 3 transport(1=http,2=maxima) 10 owner pub. Pointers refresh ~12h so the registry stays inside every fresh node's unpruned window (discovery is chain-native); ORDER coins must never be refreshed (creation height = time priority). The app gap-fills out-of-window order coins from these endpoints via coinimport track:true - blobs are self-certifying (local MMR validation), sources are untrusted for validity and interchangeable.
